name: Rasterizing Bounding Geometry for Empty Space Skipping
definition: Exploits hardware-accelerated rasterization to skip over empty space by rasterizing bounding geometries, e.g., bounding boxes of leaf nodes of a tree structure.
summary: Rasterizing Bounding Geometry for Empty Space Skipping uses hardware-accelerated rasterization to derive ray start and end points from fragment positions, avoiding GPU tree traversal and reducing data structure look-ups.
